source_audit: Pasted text audit requested tokenized grammar, high-density workplace vocabulary, structured writing metrics, and duplication checks.
implemented: Added production workplace-collocation vocabulary with corporate contexts and collocations.
Added structurally distinct Plusquamperfekt narrative items with temporal anchors.
Added tokenized TeKaMoLo matrix with tokens and generated word-order exercises.
Added adjective declension production module covering weak/mixed/strong and nominalized forms.
Added business n-declension module: Kunde, Lieferant, Praktikant, Kollege, Herr, Name.
Added abstract business prepositions: in Bezug auf, unter Bedingungen, auf Grundlage, sich wenden an, führen zu.
Added Infinitiv mit zu with separable verb placement.
Added writing tasks with required components, mandatory vocabulary, word-count metrics and model answers.
Added workplace reading documents with less trivial distractors.
Added speaking role-plays with model answers and checklists.
Updated app normalization to handle vocabulary_entries and structured writing metadata.
Replaced app icon with improved SVG logo.
not_claimed: Legacy modules were retained for breadth and backwards compatibility. The new production modules are pedagogically denser and appear first in the app manifest.
